scope: Native product classification of prescribed-velocity trace jumps on the final FvMesh2D; no independent flow equation, geometry repair, cell deletion, threshold relaxation, or boundary replacement.

mathematicalConstraint.statement: At a vertex shared by two non-collinear polygon faces, the intersection of their tangential vector subspaces is the zero vector. A nonzero single Cartesian wall velocity therefore cannot be continuous and simultaneously impermeable on both actual faces.
mathematicalConstraint.consequence: The product must retain and qualify equal-speed direction jumps at polygon corners; projecting an analytic-circle velocity onto neither actual face would violate the requested no-penetration semantics.
mathematicalConstraint.notClaimed: This classification does not make corner pressure point values convergent and is not a pressure discretization fix.

productChange.velocityTraceCauseDefinition: coordinate-invariant split of nonzero Cartesian trace jumps into speed-magnitude mismatch and equal-magnitude direction change; counts may overlap at multi-face vertices; diagnostic only
productChange.magnitudeQuantity: absolute difference of prescribed velocity magnitudes
productChange.comparisonTolerance: The existing TolerancePolicy::scale(max(reference speed, prescribed face speed)); construction floating-point comparison only, not a physical accuracy gate.
productChange.wallImpermeabilityQuantity: maximum absolute prescribed wall velocity dotted with the unit normal of each actual polygon wall face
productChange.compatibility: Existing wallTrace and velocityTrace fields retain their definitions. The cause and impermeability groups are additive; desktop validation still accepts older summaries without either group.
unchanged: flow equations and prescribed boundary values
Solver quality gates and convergence certification
failure, cancellation, checkpoint and last-accepted-state semantics

nativeUnitCoverage.equalSpeedTurningFixture: A closed square with every wall moving at unit tangential speed converged in Stokes mode and reported four equal-magnitude direction vertices, zero magnitude-discontinuous vertices, maximum Cartesian jump sqrt(2) m/s, and wall-normal prescribed speed below the report tolerance.
nativeUnitCoverage.magnitudeMismatchFixtures: The cavity lid corners and uniform-inlet/no-slip-wall duct corners each report two magnitude-discontinuous vertices and zero equal-magnitude direction vertices.

linuxDesktopPath.scope: Electron 37 headless renderer-to-IPC-to-native-CLI run; not a physical-display, macOS or packaged-App qualification.
